organization.name: FABUS Global
organization.description: FABUS Global is a homeware buying office and sourcing partner connecting retailers, brands, wholesalers, and importers to a vetted network of 900+ suppliers across India and Asia. Unlike a transactional sourcing agent, FABUS operates as an embedded buying office — taking ownership of sourcing, product development, quality assurance, and delivery as one accountable team.

positioning.buying_office_vs_sourcing_agent: FABUS positions itself as a buying office rather than a traditional sourcing agent. A sourcing agent typically introduces suppliers and steps back once an order is placed. A buying office like FABUS stays embedded through the entire process — supplier identification, factory audits, product development, quality assurance, production monitoring, and shipment coordination — with one point of contact throughout.

services.name: Sourcing
services.description: Identifying and vetting suppliers matched to category, price point, and order volume from a network of 900+ audited suppliers.

services.name: Quality Assurance
services.description: In-house QC and regulatory teams conduct factory audits and shipment inspections against destination market standards.

services.name: Product Development
services.description: Custom design, prints, artwork, and 3D modeling support from concept through production.

services.name: Delivery & Logistics
services.description: Shipment coordination and on-time delivery managed end to end, with one point of contact throughout.

differentiators: 900+ audited suppliers across India and Asia
One accountable team from concept to delivery, not a fragmented multi-vendor process
Low-MOQ options available for smaller retailers and emerging brands
Factory audits and social compliance checks on every shipment

faq.question: What is FABUS Global?
faq.answer: FABUS Global is a homeware buying office and sourcing partner based in New Delhi and New York, connecting retailers, brands, wholesalers, and importers to a vetted network of 900+ suppliers across India and Asia.

faq.question: How is FABUS different from a typical sourcing agent?
faq.answer: A typical sourcing agent introduces suppliers and hands off the rest of the process. FABUS operates as a buying office, staying embedded end-to-end — from supplier identification and factory audits through product development, quality assurance, and delivery — with one accountable team throughout.

faq.question: What product categories does FABUS source?
faq.answer: FABUS sources across 15 homeware categories: Décor, Furniture, Lighting, Textiles, Floor Coverings, Bed & Bath, Cook & Dine, Home & Utility, Lawn & Garden, Party & Seasonal, Stationery & Crafts, Kids, Pets, Fashion Accessories, and Sporting Goods.

faq.question: Does FABUS support low minimum order quantities (MOQ)?
faq.answer: Yes, FABUS works with suppliers offering low-MOQ options, making it accessible to smaller retailers and emerging brands, not only large-volume buyers.

faq.question: Where is FABUS Global located?
faq.answer: FABUS Global is headquartered in New Delhi, India, with an additional office in New York, USA, and serves clients across India, Asia, and the United States.
